name: Worldforged Ravine Sack pickup stands only in Durotar
contract: Issue #11727: the Pillaged Sack (object 95644, loot Ravine Sack 450815) was reported in two places with the same map coordinates, 49, 29: Durotar and the Barrens. The Ascension sidekick snapshot lists one location for the item, Durotar (48.7, 29.04), which is the Durotar spawn 6942068 at (784.45, -4542.41). The Barrens copy 6942067 at (-346.9, -2342.7) is removed, so no object 95644 stands at that spot while the Durotar one still loads.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: no Ravine Sack pickup at the Barrens spot
CONTROL: the Durotar Ravine Sack pickup is still there
